summary: This Wikipedia-derived note describes the city of Plymouth, covering its geography between the Rivers Plym and Tamar, its retail and listed buildings, religious life, population and ethnic makeup from the 2011 census, sports clubs, economy centred on defence and public sector, water supply history, and ferry services. It draws on census statistics and historical details such as the Plymouth Synagogue and Plymouth Gin.
one_line: Overview of Plymouth, a English city on the south coast covering its geography, population, religion, sports, economy, water supply and ferries.
key_facts: Plymouth lies between the River Plym to the east and the River Tamar to the west, both flowing into Plymouth Sound.
Since 1967, the unitary authority of Plymouth has included the towns of Plympton and Plymstock.
The Pannier Market in Plymouth city centre was completed in 1959 and is a grade II listed building.
The Tinside Pool became a grade II listed building in 1998 and was restored to its 1930s look for £3.4 million.
Plymouth's unitary authority population was 256,384 in the 2011 Census, up 15,664 from 2001.
At the 2011 census, 96.2% of Plymouth's population was White, with Chinese the largest minority group at 0.5%.
Plymouth Synagogue, built in 1762, is the oldest Ashkenazi Synagogue in the English speaking world.
Plymouth has the first known reference to Jews in the South West, in Sir Francis Drake's logs from 1577 to 1580 mentioning "Moses the Jew".
In 1831 the first Brethren assembly in England was established in Plymouth, so Brethren are often called Plymouth Brethren.
58.1% of the population described themselves as at least nominally Christian in the 2011 census, while 32.9% had no religion.
Plymouth's gross value added was 5,169 million GBP in 2013, making up 25% of Devon's GVA.
The Plymouth Gin Distillery has been producing Plymouth Gin since 1793.
Since 1973 Plymouth has been supplied water by South West Water, and Burrator Reservoir feeds most of the city's water supply.
Brittany Ferries operates a regular international ferry service from Millbay to Roscoff and Santander.
